STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.title: Navia
STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.description:
President of Spina di Rosula from Poisson — a warm-hearted and reliable demoiselle.
With her most trusted attendants and her musket-umbrella, she marches toward the Spire.

Clears every obstacle with gunfire and festive cannons.
STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.cardsModifier: Navia's cards now appear in rewards and shops.
STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.bestiaryQuote: So many things I've never seen! Can I get a photo with it?
STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.goldMonologue: [sine][gold]These funds will enrich the Spina's coffers...[/gold][/sine]
STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.unlockText: A new adventure awaits the president of the Spina.
